description: Rank protein sources available in India by cost in rupees per 10 g of protein, cheapest first: soya chunks, dals, eggs, chana, curd, milk, paneer and protein powders. Use it to answer 'cheapest way to get protein in India'. Whole foods are reported as cheaper than every powder, including KABO's. Read-only; values are approximate typical retail prices, not live quotes.
